answers.question: Each loading screen is the clip and nothing else: no overlay, no LOG, no sound toggle, exactly 5.0 seconds. What is a loading screen to you?
SKIP is offered during every loading clip and every walk, so no room is a dead end. Do you want people to use it?
Phone or desktop first: which one do you play it on yourself?
The three mini games (Lights Out, Fill the Frames, Shopping List) are bonuses: the exit is open from the start. Should any of them ever gate the exit?
Only three of the seven rooms have a mini game. What about the other four (hallway, both teal rooms, trampoline park)?
Which room is the best to walk, and which feels unfinished?
